evidence.quote: Net Mass/Weight (Spot with battery) 33.8 kg (74.5 lb)

notes.zh: 回答工业巡检型四足的尺寸、防护与地形能力，重点在 IP54 与 -20 至 55°C 的工况范围，这是它区别于轻量科研机型的地方。不回答自主导航能到什么程度：官方页面只给感知视场与测距，自主性取决于所配软件与载荷。
notes.en: Answers the dimensions, ingress protection and terrain capability of an industrial inspection quadruped, where IP54 and a -20 to 55 °C operating range are what distinguish it from lightweight research platforms. It does not answer how far autonomy goes: the page gives perception field of view and range only, and autonomy depends on the software and payload fitted.

specs.dimensions: 1100 mm L x 500 mm W; 610 mm default walking height
specs.terrain sensing: 360° horizontal field of view, 4 m range, works above 2 lux
